edges.rationale: The file lives directly inside apps/frontend/src/assets/avatar/.
Identical MD5 hash 561905ab8bb7ce0f4e0ed41881b0659a appears for the matching file in apps/backend/uploads/avatars/, indicating it is a copy used as seeded backend data.
Filename avatar_1_<ts>.jpeg pairs the asset with user id 1; the rationale node represents that mapping.
Profile.jsx reads user.avatar (lines 525, 916, 995, 1933) to render the profile photo and provides upload/remove/crop actions.
Navbar.jsx line 429-432 reads user?.avatar for the top-right avatar display.
BottomNav.jsx line 81-89 reads user?.avatar for the mobile nav on /profile.
TestInterface.jsx line 1331-1332 shows user?.avatar during an active test.
TestReview.jsx line 711-712 shows user?.avatar on the results screen.
Settings.jsx line 399 calls userAPI.updateProfile({ avatar: reader.result }) to replace the user avatar.
assets-config.js defines defaultAvatar and getAvatarUrl() helpers that fall back when the user avatar is missing.
shared/types/index.js line 140 explicitly maps backendUser.avatar into the frontend User type, propagating the avatar URL through the app.
.profile-avatar CSS rules in index.css control the appearance of the rendered avatar image.
Profile.jsx uses the .profile-avatar class to frame the displayed image.
